description: SaaS security obligations vs SOC-style audit report: encryption tested; backup restoration explicitly not tested

documents.title: Platform Services Agreement
documents.text:
# Platform Services Agreement

This Agreement is made between Quillfeather Software Ltd (the "Supplier") and Thistledown Lettings Ltd (the "Customer").

## 9. Security
9.1 The Supplier shall encrypt all Customer Data at rest using AES-256.
9.2 The Supplier shall test the restoration of Customer Data from back-up at least once every 6 months.
9.3 The Supplier shall enforce multi-factor authentication for all administrative access to the Platform.

documents.title: Independent Controls Report 2026
documents.text:
# Independent Controls Report - Quillfeather Software Ltd

Period covered: 1 January 2026 to 30 June 2026. Prepared by Ravensholt Assurance LLP.

## 4. Results of Testing
4.1 Encryption at rest: we inspected the storage configuration for all production databases and confirmed that AES-256 encryption at rest was enabled. No exceptions noted.
4.2 Administrative access: we sampled 25 administrator accounts and confirmed multi-factor authentication was enforced for all 25. No exceptions noted.

## 5. Scope Limitations
5.1 Back-up restoration testing was outside the scope of this engagement and we did not test it.

test the restoration of Customer Data from back-up
multi-factor authentication for all administrative access
